demonstracao_cypher.consulta_recomendacao: MATCH (todas:Obra) WITH count(todas) AS n MATCH (t:Tag) WHERE t.nome IN $tags MATCH (t)<-[:TEM_TAG]-(o) WITH n, t, collect(o) AS obras WITH t, obras, 1.0 + log(toFloat(n) / size(obras)) AS peso UNWIND obras AS o WITH o, sum(peso) AS score, count(t) AS comuns WHERE NOT o.titulo IN $excluir RETURN o.titulo AS titulo, o.tipo AS tipo, comuns, round(score, 2) AS score ORDER BY score DESC, comuns DESC, titulo LIMIT 60
